metadata.title: 5 Curative Title Terms Every Investor Should Understand
metadata.author: Courtney Fricke
metadata.shortDescription:
Most investors hear terms like quitclaim deed, cloud on title, and quiet title action but don't really understand what they mean. In this episode, I break down five of the most common curative title terms every investor should know and explain them in plain English.

What You'll Learn
-What fee simple ownership means
-How chain of title works
-What creates a cloud on title
-Why quitclaim deeds are misunderstood
-When a quiet title action may be necessary

CHAPTERS FOR THIS EPISODE:
00:00 Why Title Problems Kill Deals
01:12 What Is Fee Simple Title?
05:18 What Is Chain of Title?
10:47 What Is a Cloud on Title?
16:05 What Is a Quitclaim Deed?
21:37 What Is a Quiet Title Action?
28:10 Five Questions Every Investor Should Ask
31:22 Final Thoughts

ATTENTION:
The information shared in this episode is for educational and informational purposes only and reflects personal experiences and opinions. It is not intended as legal, tax, financial, or investment advice. Real Estate laws, tax rules, and regulations vary by state and situation. Always consult with a qualified attorney, CPA, or other licensed professional before making any Real Estate or financial decisions.
